title: Flamethrower
description: This revolutionary new item allows you to throw flames in the direction that you are looking at.
body:
This datapack adds flamethrowers to the base game in the form of a datapack + resourcepack.

# Flamethrower
![A flamethrower laying down on a table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/055707c883f17d56e66fdc0fca7288e84e7194a0.png)
When the flamethrower is used, it produces flame particles out from the nozzle, and burns any entity that touches it. When said flame particles reach the ground, it will set the ground ablaze.

## Mechanics
- The flames travel up to 20 meters in length over the course of 1.5 seconds. 
- The flames will bounce off surfaces. 
- The flamethrower can **only** be used on the **mainhand**.
- The flamethrower is **invulnerable to fire**.
- If you are holding a flamethrower with fuel, you will explode upon death.
- **YOU ARE NOT IMMUNE TO YOUR OWN FLAMES**, so be weary of your surroundings.

## Recipes
- The flamethrower can be crafted by placing a lava bucket in the center, 5 iron ingots in the form of a minecart, a flint and steel in the top left position, and 2 netherite ingots for fire invulnerability.

  ![the recipe for a flamethrower](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05e8a4ffe12a4cb4cb8ea984bdb46fd972a1e547.png)

### Refueling
There are 2 ways to refuel the flamethrower
1. **Crafting Recipe** : Put the flamethrower together with a bucket of lava to repair it.
   ![flamethrower repair recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9231254f52d423e12e916bb9634879aab5785e1.png)
2. **Rawdogging** : Stand in lava while holding the flamethrower to refill automagically.
   ![Imagine a player standing in lava while their flamethrower is refueled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c234b49aba782239887c96cc7385ca9744a4263_0.webp)
